evidence: Carries IPC area label, introduces Cap'n Proto schemas and proxies in src/ipc/, and updates the libmultiprocess subtree.
rationale: Exposing the Chain interface over IPC directly unblocks running the wallet in a separate process (#10102). As the description notes, processes connecting over IPC 'can't currently use the Chain interface read chain data or follow chain events', which blocks out-of-process wallet separation as well as external consumers.
